Santner (2/2): [On New Zealand's bowling depth] Yeah, I think we're in a great spot in terms of depth at the moment. I guess with the schedule there's been a lot more rotation than probably would be. But it gives guys opportunities, which is nice. Some fringe guys who don't potentially play a lot. And they're showing that they can step up straight away, which is cool as well. So in terms of the depth like you talked about, we're in a good spot. [On Glenn Phillips' consistency] Yeah, I mean to do it every game is pretty special. He does give himself a little bit of time and then he can hit some good areas, play some strong shots. And against a good bowling attack as we've seen. They're a great side. So for him to do it every game and put us in great positions with the bat, like you said at the start, I think the batting's been really good. You know, 200 most games and then obviously a 260 as well. So yeah, and he was a crucial part of that.
